<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,664)><$voicel(2,7)>Em resultado disso, consegui carregar as bochechas com muita
de eletricidade!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,8)>Oho! Are you saying you can use electricity again?!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,8)>Está dizendo que pode usar eletricidade novamente?!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,4)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,4)>Well, as I had guessed, I still cannot GENERATE
electricity...
<$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,6)>But this device has allowed me to ABSORB plenty of it!
<$lookat(2,0,0)><$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,7)>And now I have a very special move in mind—one I’ve
been waiting a very long time to use!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,4)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,4)>Bem, como eu tinha adivinhado, ainda não consigo gerar
electricidade...
<$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,6)>Mas este dispositivo permitiu-me a ABSORVar bastante!
<$lookat(2,0,0)><$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,7)>E agora eu tenho uma jogada muito especial em mente – uma que eu tenho
esperou muito tempo para usar!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,3)>What in the world are you planning?
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,3)>O que está a planear?

dialogues.en:
<$lookat(2,0,0)><$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,6)>This particular move ought to light up the town even
brighter than it already is! <$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,7)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,3)>Well, without further ado...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$lookat(2,0,0)><$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,6)>Este movimento em particular deve iluminar a cidade até mesmo
Mais brilhante do que já é! <$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,7)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,3)>Bem, sem mais delongas...

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,5)><$facial(2,7)><$voicel(2,9)><$textsize(2)>PIIIKAAA...CHUUUUUU!!!</textsize>
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,5)><$facial(2,7)><$voicel(2,9)><$textsize(2)>PIIIKAAA...CHUUUUUUU!!!!</textsize>

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,665)><$voicel(1,10)>Oho! Would you look at that! So incredibly bright!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,665)><$voicel(1,10)>Vejam só, tão brilhante!

dialogues.en: <$lookat(2,0,0)><$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,9)>Phew! That went well, I think. Was I of any help at all?
dialogues.pt_br: <$lookat(2,0,0)><$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,9)>Isso correu bem, acho eu.

dialogues.en:
<$lookat(1,0,2)><$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Most certainly! I had no idea you could use a move
like that!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$lookat(1,0,2)><$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Eu não tinha idéia que você poderia usar um movimento
Assim!

dialogues.en: <$lookat(4,0,2)><$comeff(5,10)><$facial(5,4)><$motion(5,801)><$voicel(5,7)>You’re AMAZING, <$cdef(27)>Peakychu</color>!
dialogues.pt_br: <$lookat(4,0,2)><$comeff(5,10)><$facial(5,4)><$motion(5,801)><$voicel(5,7)>Você é incrível, <$cdef(27)>Peakychu</color>!

dialogues.en: <$lookat(5,0,2)><$comeff(4,21)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,9)>My coin’s all shiny too!
dialogues.pt_br: <$lookat(5,0,2)><$comeff(4,21)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,9)>Minha moeda é toda brilhante também!

dialogues.en: <$lookat(6,0,2)><$comeff(6,9)><$facial(6,4)><$motion(6,803)><$voicel(6,8)>Yooo! It’s BEAUTIFUL, <$cdef(27)>Peakychu</color>! And so bright!
dialogues.pt_br: <$lookat(6,0,2)><$comeff(6,9)><$facial(6,4)><$motion(6,803)><$voicel(6,8)>É lindo. <$cdef(27)>Peakychu</color>E tão brilhante!

dialogues.en:
<$lookat(2,0,0)><$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,664)><$voicel(2,8)>Tee-hee! Thank you all for your kind words. I’m just glad I
was able to be of use...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$lookat(2,0,0)><$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,664)><$voicel(2,8)>Tee-hee! Obrigado a todos por suas palavras amáveis. Estou apenas feliz que eu
foi capaz de ser útil...

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,6)>Well then, shall we go check in on <$cdef(27)>Snorlax and see how
they’re doing?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,6)>Bem, então, vamos ver como está. <$cdef(27)>Snorlax e ver como
eles estão fazendo?
